svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'Malgun Gothic', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three ways to run a server, each the same server: in the launcher, by turning on Open this PC's server on its Online page, for the other PCs on its network while the launcher is open; with Docker Compose, ./dmt3 setup, a wizard in the terminal, on Linux, macOS or Windows in WSL 2; with Python 3.10 or newer on Linux, python -m opendmt3.server. Each way it is the game on port 4725, the site and its API on port 4730, one SQLite file and its backups in a data folder, and the song list read once from the client data.
svg.text: Runs while the launcher is open,
for the PCs on its network.
